kāyakamma.p: [Kāya+kamma] (na) CL=7 (A) The physical action that arises on the body door. The intention or an action that is done by the body door. The physical action. Kāyakamma. (B) The action of physical misconduct.

CPD: kāya-kamma, n. [ Buddh. sa. kāyakarman, cf. SWTF, q.v. ] , a. bodily action ( in contrast to vacī‑°, mano-kam­ma), cf. kāya­vacīkamma, q.v.; b . t. t. Vin in the classi­fi­ca­tion of the samuṭṭhāna s, cf. O. v. Hinüber, JPTS XVl 1992: 55–69 and āpatti 1.d.(β), q.v. ; — a. exeg.: kāyena ce kataṃ kammaṃ ~an ti vuccati kāyo ca ~añ ca añña­mañ­ñaṃ vavatthitā, As 85, 21 * foll. ( qu. Aṭṭha­kathācariyā); tīṇi kusalamūlāni … viññāṇa­kkhandho taṃ­sam­uṭṭhānaṃ ~aṃ vacī­kammaṃ mano­kammaṃ, Dhs 981 = 1017 = 1294 ≠ Vibh 208 qu. (vinā pi cittena ~aṃ pavattati, Moh 271, 32 ); kusalaṃ ~aṃ manodvāre samuṭṭhāti, As 94, 24 ; kāya­dvārapavattañ hi kammaṃ ~aṃ, 344, 21 ; Moh 22, 8 ; kāyato pavatte kāyena vā pavatte ~e, Nidd-a l 115, 6 ; dāna­sīlâdi­kāya­kammānaṃ kāyadvāre pava­ttiyaṃ kam­maṃ ~am eva … vacīdvāre pavattiyaṃ kammaṃ ~am eva +, Moh 24, 34 ; yā pana tasmiṃ dvāre ( sc. kāyakam­ma­dvāre) siddhā cetanā yāya pāṇaṃ hanti … idaṃ ~aṃ, As 84, 27 ; sahatthena pūjen­tassa pavattati tadā ~aṃ … āṇāpe­tvā pūjā­pentassa tadā vacī­kammaṃ … vaṇṇa­dānaṃ das­sāmîti cinteti tadā mano­kammaṃ, 77, 22 foll.; Abhidh-s-mhṭ 133, 1 ; suttaṃ … bhāsati idaṃ vacīkammaṃ, yaṃ añ­ja­liṃ paṇāmeti idaṃ ~aṃ, so manopasādo idaṃ mano­kam­maṃ Peṭ 168, 20 ; ~aṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ ~unā pana sa­ha pavattaṃ oṭṭha­pa­rip­phan­danaṃ bhākuṭikaraṇaṃ +, Ps-pṭ l 252, 5 ; ~an ti saka­la­liṅgadhāraṇapaṭipadânu­yog­âbhi­vāda­napaccupaṭ­ṭhā­nâñ­jali­kam­mâdikāyakammaṃ, Paṭis-a 442, 13 ; kāyaviñ­ñat­ti­saṅ­khāte kāyadvāre bāhulla­vuttito ~aṃ, Abhidh-s 25, 6 (Abhidh-s-mhṭ 132, 26 foll. ); ~aṃ sanidassanaṃ, Kv 334, 8 (Kv-a 93, 12 foll. ); — samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ~aṃ pari­sodhesuṃ +, M l 420, 2 ; yaṃ … ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kam­maṃ kattukāmo, idaṃ me ~aṃ attabyābādhāya pi saṃ­vatteyya +, 415, 27 ( cf. appiyaṃ ~aṃ, Ps lll 129, 13 ); byāpādo manoduccaritaṃ ~aṃ upaṭṭhapeti, Peṭ 39, 17 ; ~assa uppajjanaṭṭhānan (As 85, 4 ) ti taṃsaha­jātā viññatti yeva vuccati, As-mṭ 74, 24 ; — pañc’ime … phāsuvihārā … mettaṃ ~aṃ paccuppaṭṭhitaṃ +, A lll 132, 11 (metta­cit­tena pavattitaṃ ~aṃ, Mp lll 279, 6 ); cha sārāṇīyā dhammā … bhikkhuno mettaṃ ~aṃ paccupaṭṭhi­taṃ hoti sabrahma­cārīsu … vacī‑°, mano‑°, D lll 245, 10 foll. ≠ A lll 288, 22 (mettena cittena kātabbaṃ ~aṃ, Mp lll 338, 7 ); Vin l 351, 26 = M l 206, 22 (mettacittavasena pavattaṃ ~aṃ, Ps ll 239, 18 ) = lll 156, 15 ; Vin V 92, 28 (mettacittena kataṃ ~aṃ … sammukhā mettaṃ ~aṃ … parammukhā mettaṃ ~aṃ, Sp 1316, 9 foll.; bhikkhūnañ hi mettacittena ācari­yu­paj­jhāyavattâdiābhisamācārika­dham­ma­pūraṇaṃ met­taṃ ~aṃ, Sp-ṭ lll 459, 2 ); bhikkhū mettaṃ ~aṃ paccu­paṭ­ṭhā­pes­santi sa­brahmacārīsu, D ll 80, 9 (mettacittena kattab­baṃ ~aṃ, Sv 531, 24 ; mettaṃ cittaṃ, taṃsamuṭṭhānaṃ ~aṃ, Sv-pṭ ll 169, 4 ) = M l 322, 8 (mettacittena kātabbaṃ kam­maṃ, Ps ll 395, 2 ); dīgha­rattaṃ kho te … tathāgato paccuppaṭṭhito ~ena mettena hitena +, D ll 144, 16 (metta­cit­tavasena pavattitena mukha­dhovanâdidānena ~ena, Sv 584, 27 ); Th 1044; samaṇa­­brāhmaṇā paccuppaṭṭhitabbā mettena ~ena +, D lll 191, 15 (katāni ~âdīni … vihāra­gama­naṃ … piṭṭhipari­kam­ma­pāda­parikammâdikaraṇañ ca mettaṃ ~aṃ, Sv 957, 9 foll. ); — natthi tathāgatassa kāya­duccaritaṃ (D lll 217, 9 ) … sabbaṃ ~aṃ buddhassa bhaga­vato ñāṇânu­parivatti … vacī‑°, mano‑°, Sv 994, 7 foll. (bhagavato sabbaṃ ~aṃ ñāṇa­pubbaṅgamaṃ ñāṇânu­pari­vatti, Sv-pṭ lll 257, 12 ); Nidd l 178, 21 = Paṭis ll 195, 4 = Nett 17, 25 qu. Th-a lll 10, 34 ; kāyaviññattivasena pavattaṃ akusalaṃ ~aṃ kāyadu­ccaritaṃ, Sp-ṭ l 403, 9 ; kāyaduccaritan ti pāṇâtipātâdi ti­vidhaṃ akusalaṃ ~aṃ, Mp ll 91, 4 foll.; ~aṃ vacīkammaṃ ājīvo parisuddho, M lll 289, 7 qu. Kv 601, 11 ( cf. Ps V 104, 4 ) = Vism 11, 33 = Vibh-a 123, 12 ; Sv 181, 2 ( qu. M ll 27, 3 ); kāyindriya­saṃ­varo ~an ti, Kv 463, 10 ; dhammikaṃ rakkhâva­raṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati ~asmiṃ, A l 110, 13 ; citte rakkhite taṃ rak­khi­taṃ bhavati ~aṃ, Nett 109, 2 ; citte arakkhite ~am pi arakkhitaṃ, A l 262, 3 qu. As 68, 28 ; — ariyasāvako an­avaj­jena ~ena samannāgato +, A ll 69, 30 ; santaṃ yeva kāya­kammaṃ vacī‑°, mano‑°, l 65, 27 ; °âdīnaṃ santatāya santo, Ja l 131, 27 ´ ; padakkhiṇaṃ ~aṃ, A l 294, 26 * (vaḍ­ḍhi­kāya­kammaṃ, Mp ll 383, 8 ); saṇho (Sn 853) ti saṇhena ~ena samannāgato, Nidd l 234, 6 (apharusena mudunā ~ena, Nidd-a l 340, 2 ); puggalo sāvajjena ~ena samannā­gato, A ll 135, 26 qu. Pp 41, 2 (Pp-a 222, 13 ); hīnā narâti (Sn 776) hīnena ~ena samannā­gatā, Nidd l 48, 4 ; pāpa­bhik­khu visamena ~ena samannāgato, A l 154, 20 (sapak­kha­la­naṭṭhena visa­mena kāyadvārikakammena, Mp ll 254, 20 ); visamaṃ ~aṃ visaman ti jāneyya, Nidd l 41, 2 ( on Sn 775); visame niviṭṭhâti visame ~e, 37, 27 ( on Sn 774; Nidd-a l 115, 6 ); Pj ll 287, 1 ( on Sn 243); visamaṃ ~aṃ abhiruhati, Nidd l 145, 29 (kāyaduccaritasaṅkhā­taṃ visamaṃ ~aṃ, Nidd-a l 272, 9 ); Ja lV 67, 11 ´ ; pāṇâtipātī … tassa jimhaṃ ~aṃ … pāṇâtipātaṃ pahāya … ujuṃ ~aṃ, A V 289, 4– 290, 18 ; (sīvathi­kûpamo) puggalo asucinā ~ena sam­annāgato, lll 269, 1 ; ~aṃ suci nesaṃ … tena me sama­ṇā piyā, Thī 277 ≠ Dhp-a lll 467, 22 * ; sucīhi ca °âdīhi samannā­gatassa, Ps l 179, 10 ; kāmôdhinā rahitaṃ … ~aṃ +, Ja lV 174, 17 ´ ; °âdīsu aparā­dhara­hitaṃ, Vl 477, 17 ´ ( so read with Be, Ce [SHB]; Ee kāyikak°); — bhikkhū bhattagge … vivādâpannā añña­maññaṃ ananu­lomikaṃ ~aṃ vacīkammaṃ upadaṃsenti, Vin l 341, 3 (kāyena paha­rantā, Sp 1150, 3 ); tassa ( sc. amittassa) ~am pi vacī­kam­mam pi na roceti, Ja ll 132, 4 ´ ; isayo … na pharu­sa­va­ca­nehi ~ena vā ghaṭṭento upa­gaccheyya, V 272, 31 ´ ( Be °vacanena); ty ( sc. te sabrahma­cārino) assa bahu­laṃ manā­pen’eva ~ena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, A lll 33, 20 ; — katame ca, thapati, akusa­la­sīlā? akusalaṃ ~aṃ +, M ll 26, 10 qu. Sv 182, 2 ≠ lt-a l 104, 2 ( reading gahapati for thapati); kāyaduccaritaṃ … akusala­kāya­sañ­cetanā akusalaṃ ~aṃ, Vibh 364, 8 ; tividhā … kāya­sañ­cetanā akusalaṃ ~aṃ dukhu­drayaṃ, Kv 393, 24 qu. Hin­über, Selec­ted Papers 2 2005: 154); — tīṇi kammāni … paññā­pemi … pāpassa kammassa pavat­tiyā seyyathīdaṃ ~aṃ vacī‑° mano‑°, M l 373, 10 , (vīsaticetanā ~aṃ, Ps lll 53, 20 ); cf. ( on pa­kiṇ­ṇa­kaṃ, Sp 270, 16 foll. ), cf. Sv 993, 6 foll.; atthi sikkhā­padaṃ ~aṃ atthi vacīkammaṃ. tattha yaṃ kāya­dvāri­kaṃ taṃ ~aṃ Sp 271, 3 (Vmv l 150, 6 ); sabbā câpattiyo kamma­vasena tividhā siyuṃ ~aṃ vacī­kammaṃ tathā tad­u­bhayam pi ca, Utt-vn 866; pāṇâtipātâdayo ~aṃ … jāta­rūpa­rajatappaṭiggaha­naṃ pana ~aṃ vā siyā vacī­kammaṃ vā, Pj l 35, 22 ; — sacittakaṃ lokavajjaṃ ~aṃ vacī­kam­maṃ akusalacittaṃ, Sp 463, 25 = Kkh(2) 40, 17 ; acittakaṃ paṇṇattivajjaṃ ~aṃ vacīkam­maṃ ticittaṃ tiveda­naṃ, Sp 574, 22 ; akiriyaṃ … loka­vajjaṃ ~aṃ vacī­kammaṃ, 611, 8 ; Vin-vn 434; sacittakaṃ lokavajjaṃ ~aṃ vacīkam­maṃ, Sp 740, 8 (kāyavikāra­mattena pi oma­sa­nasam­bhava­to … ~an ti, Vmv ll 3, 11 ); nosaññā­vi­mok­khaṃ acittakaṃ paṇṇattivajjaṃ ~aṃ vacī­kammaṃ ti­cittaṃ tivedanaṃ, Sp 864, 8 (pari­bhogo ettha ~aṃ, apaccud­dhāra­ṇaṃ vacīkam­maṃ, Vjb 330, 9 ; Sp-ṭ lll 82, 12 ); saha­kam­ma­vācāyâti (Sv 979, 15 ) … āpatti­vuṭ­ṭhānaṃ … paññat­ti­lak­khaṇaṃ ~aṃ vacī­kam­maṃ vā, Sv-pṭ lll 230, 24 ; — vācā ~assa upa­kārikā, Sv 315, 22 ( Ee w.r. sammāvācā) = Vibh-a 116, 7 qu. Paṭis-a 163, 33 ; sāhatthikâṇattike vacī­kammaṃ … ~assa upa­nissayaṃ jā­taṃ, cittaṃ viya tattha aṅgam eva jātaṃ, Vjb 140, 26 ( on Sp 373, 22 , cf. 304, 12 ); — ifc. kusala‑ °; ṭhita‑ °; diṭṭhânu­lomika‑ °; diṭṭhi-saha­jāta‑ °; pavatta‑ °; metta‑ °; vaḍḍhi‑ °; vutta‑ °; — °‑ ññatā, f., adaptability, wieldi­ness (Ñm) of the body; ~ā hoti citta­kam­maññatā, Dhs 1 = 147; katamā … ~ā? … vedanā­khan­dhassa sañ­ñā­khan­dhassa saṅkhārak­khan­dhassa kam­mañ­ñatā +, Dhs 46 = 326 (kāyassa kammaññabhāvo, As 130, 28 ) qu. Abhidh­-s 6, 18 (Abhidh-s-mhṭ 85, 20 ); kāya­cittānaṃ akammañña­bhāva­vupa­sama­lak­khaṇā ~ā citta­kam­maññatā ca, Moh 15, 27 ; kāya­kammaññabhāvo ~ā, Vism 465, 35 ; — ° ‑dvāra, n., door of bodily action, cf. kāya­dvāra , q.v.; kāyakam­massa uppajjanaṭṭhānaṃ ~an ti, As 85, 4 tīṇi kamma­dvārāni … ~aṃ, vacī‑°, mano‑° … ~an ti … citta­sam­uṭ­ṭhā­ne­su pana aṭṭhasu rūpesu ekā viññatti, 82, 3–22 ; kāya­kam­maṃ pana ~amhi bahulaṃ pavattati, 85, 35 ; — ~‑kathā, f., title of As 82, 11– 86, 3 ; ~ā, As 86, 4 ; ~‑ kathā-vaṇṇanā, f., title of As-mṭ 72, 1– 75, 7 ; As-mṭ 75, 8 ;— °(´)‑anta, m. [ Buddh. sa. kāya-karmānta, cf. SWTF q. v. ] , bodily action; ~ena, Ps l 113, 28 ; A V 292, 23 (Mp V 77, 2 ); — ifc. aparisuddha ‑°; avassuta‑ °; sāvajja ‑°; — ~‑vāra-kathā, f., title of Ps l 113, 8– 114, 23 ; ~ā, Ps l 114, 23 ; — ~ vāra ‑ kathā-vaṇṇanā, f., title of Ps-pṭ l 210, 1– 212, 15 ; Ps-pṭ l 212, 16 ; — ~‑sadisa, mfn., as in the para­graph on bodily action, i.e. Ps l 114, 3 foll.; ti ~aṃ vitthāre­tabbaṃ, Ps l 116, 26 ; — ~‑sandosa-vyāpatti, f. [ Buddh. sa. kāyakarma-vipatti, cf. SWTF q. v. ], ruinous conduct by defilement of bodily action; tividhā ~i, A V 292, 12 (kāyakammasaṃ­khātā vi­pat­ti, Mp V 77 ,2 ), i.e. indulging in pāṇâtipāta, adin­nâ­dāna, kāmesu micchācāra; — ~‑sampatti, f., accomp­lish­ment in bodily action; tividhā ~i, A V 295, 2 , i.e. aban­doning pāṇâtipāta, adinnâdāna, kāmesu micchā­cāra, cf. Peṭ 70, 17 foll.; — °‑ paccaya, m., bodily action as con­di­tion; ~ena, Mp lll 175, 10 ; — °‑ pāri­suddhi, f., purity of bodily action; tisso … pārisuddhiyo ~i +, Peṭ 10, 15 , cf. A V 295, 3 ; — °‑bhāva, m., the being bodily action; ~o, As 86, 1 ; Abhidh-s-mhṭ 133, 11 ; — °‑ vacī-kamma, n. [ Buddh. sa. kāyakarma-vākkarman, cf. SWTF q. v. ] , bodily and verbal action, cf. kāya-vacī­kamma , q.v.; ~ena samannā­gato kusalena, D l 63, 16 (ācāra­gocara-gahaṇen’eva kusale ~e gahite pi, Sv 181, 25 ; Sv-pṭ l 312, 28 ) = 171, 28 ≠ Nett 185, 5 (Nett-a 263, 14 foll. ); ~āni nāma paresaṃ pākaṭāni … mano­kammaṃ pana apākaṭaṃ, Sp 952, 17 = Ps ll 173, 10 = Mp lll 23, 8 qu. Ud-a 26, 6 ; kittake pana ṭhāne ~āni … sodhetabbāni, Ps lll 129, 8 ; ~āni kamman ti laddhi, Spk ll 342, 18 ( on S lll 211, 22 ); — t. t. Vin.: one of the samuṭṭhāna s, cf. s. v. kāya­kamma b., q.v., Ee often w. r. °kammaṃ vacī°: ubhayattha ( sc. kāyadvāre, vacīdvāre) āpajjitabbā ( sc. āpatti) ~añ ca, Kkh(2) 38, 13 ( so read, qu. Sp-ṭ ll 97, 25 ); Vmv l 150, 11 ; ~aṃ Sp 668, 16 ; 732, 14 ; — ~‑mano­kamma, n., bodily, verbal and mental action; ~assa nirodhā vimutti, S lV 132, 24 ; ~āni duccarita­vasena vibhattāni, Nidd-a l 115, 8 ; — ~‑vipphandita-vinayana , mfn., dis­pel­ling the misconduct by bodily and verbal action; ~aṃ Vina­ya­piṭakaṃ pakāsesi, Sp 103 ,22 (kāya­dvāresu ajjhā­cāra­vasena pavattassa kilesa­vipphandi­tas­sa vinayana­karaṃ, Sp-ṭ l 188, 3 ); — ° âdhiṭṭhāna, n., expres­sion in terms of bodily action (Ñm); katamaṃ suttâdhiṭ­ṭhānaṃ ( so read, Peṭ-trsl 77, n. 194/1)? … + ~aṃ + …, Peṭ 60, 3–5 ; 69, 18 ; khīṇâsavassa kathaṃ kāyo na hoti: na tassa ~an ti, Spk-pṭ ll 70, 18 ( on Spk ll 58, 28 ). — Rem.: The Buddhist term kāyakamma corresponds and is opposed to the Jain term kāyadaṇḍa, q.v., as discussed in the Upāli­suttanta, M l 372, 8– 373, 28 .

kāyakammaññatā.p: [Kāyakammañña+tā] (thī) CL=7 [Kammani sādhu kammaññaṃ, tassa bhāvo kammaññatā, kāyassa kammaññatā kāyakammaññatā. Vibhāvinī. 110.] As the dignified state in all mental properties. Wieldiness of the body. (The nature or characteristics that have the power which is able to do wholesome deeds).
a: ကာယကမ္မညတာ(ထီ)
ကမ္မနိ သာဓု ကမ္မညံ၊ တဿ ဘာဝေါ ကမ္မညတာ၊ ကာယဿ ကမ္မညတာ ကာယကမ္မညတာ။ ဝိဘာဝိနီ။ ၁၁ဝ။]  စေတသိက်အပေါင်း၏အမှု၌ ခံ့သည်၏အဖြစ်၊ ကာယကမ္မညတာစေတသိက်။(ကောင်းမှုပြုခြင်း၌ စွမ်းနိုင်သော သတ္တိရှိသောတရား)။

F: Kāyakammaññatā，﹐【阴】心所适业性（堪能），去除心所（cetasika）的不适业性（akammaññabhāva）。
B:
kāyakammaññatā： kāyakammaññatā（thī）
ကာယကမ္မညတာ（ထီ）
[kāyakammañña+tā．kammani sādhu kammaññaṃ，tassa bhāvo kammaññatā，kāyassa kammaññatā kāyakammaññatā．vibhāvinī．11va．]
[ကာယကမ္မည+တာ။ ကမ္မနိ သာဓု ကမ္မညံ၊ တဿ ဘာဝေါ ကမ္မညတာ၊ ကာယဿ ကမ္မညတာ ကာယကမ္မညတာ။ ဝိဘာဝိနီ။ ၁၁ဝ။]
K:
kāyakammaññatā：ကာယကမ္မညတာ （ထီ）
[ကာယကမ္မည+တာ။ ကမ္မနိ သာဓု ကမ္မညံ၊ တဿ ဘာဝေါ ကမ္မညတာ၊ ကာယဿ ကမ္မညတာ ကာယကမ္မညတာ။ ဝိဘာဝိနီ။ ၁၁ဝ။]
စေတသိက်အပေါင်း၏အမှု၌ ခံ့သည်၏အဖြစ်၊ ကာယကမ္မညတာစေတသိက်။ （ကောင်းမှုပြုခြင်း၌ စွမ်းနိုင်သော သတ္တိရှိသောတရား）။
R:
kāyakammaññatā：ကာယ-ကမ္မညတာ （ဣ）
စေတသိက်တို့၏ အမှု၌ ခံ့ခြင်း။

kāyakali.p: [Kāya+kali] (pu) CL=7 The offense or flaw of the body.
a: ကိုယ်ဟုဆိုအပ်သော အပြစ်၊ ကိုယ်အပြစ်။

B:
kāyakali： kāyakali（pu）
ကာယကလိ（ပု）
[kāya+kali]
[ကာယ+ကလိ]
K:
kāyakali：ကာယကလိ （ပု）
[ကာယ+ကလိ]
ကိုယ်ဟုဆိုအပ်သော အပြစ်၊ ကိုယ်အပြစ်။
R:
kāyakali：ကာယ-ကလိ （ပ）
ကိုယ်၏ ဆုံးရှုံးခြင်း။
CPD: kāya-kali, m. [ ts. , cf. SWTF s.v. ] , worst of bodies; ~inā asārena, Thī 458; ~ino, 501 (kāyasaṅkhātassa kalino, Thī-a 264, 17 ), cf. EV ll on Thī 458.

kāyakammanta.p: [Kāyakamma+anta] (pu) CL=7 The action that is done by the body door. Physical action.
a: ကာယကမ္မန္တ(ပု)
ကာယဒွါရဖြင့် ပြုအပ်သောအမှု၊ ကာယကံ။

B:
kāyakammanta： kāyakammanta（pu）
ကာယကမ္မန္တ（ပု）
[kāyakamma+anta]
[ကာယကမ္မ+အန္တ]
K:
kāyakammanta：ကာယကမ္မန္တ（ပု）
[ကာယကမ္မ+အန္တ]
ကာယဒွါရဖြင့် ပြုအပ်သောအမှု၊ ကာယကံ။
R:
kāyakammanta：ကာယ-ကမ္မန္တ （ပ）
ကိုယ်၏ အမူအရာ။

kāyakammantasampatti.p: [Kāyakammanta+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment of physical action.
a: ကာယကမ္မန္တသမ္ပတ္တိ(ထီ)
[ကာယကမ္မန္တ+သမ္ပတ္တိ]
ကာယကံ၏ပြည့်စုံခြင်း။

B:
kāyakammantasampatti： kāyakammantasampatti（thī）
ကာယကမ္မန္တသမ္ပတ္တိ（ထီ）
[kāyakammanta+sampatti]
[ကာယကမ္မန္တ+သမ္ပတ္တိ]
K:
kāyakammantasampatti：ကာယကမ္မန္တသမ္ပတ္တိ （ထီ）
[ကာယကမ္မန္တ+သမ္ပတ္တိ]
ကာယကံ၏ပြည့်စုံခြင်း။

kāyakammantasandosabyāpatti.p: [Kāyakammantasandosa+byāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Corruption and failure of physical action that action is unwholesome.
a: ကာယကမ္မန္တသန္ဒောသဗျာပတ္တိ(ထီ)
[ကာယကမ္မန္တသန္ဒောသ+ဗျာပတ္တိ]
အပြစ်ရှိသော ကာယကံပျက်စီးမှု။

B:
kāyakammantasandosabyāpatti： kāyakammantasandosabyāpatti（thī）
ကာယကမ္မန္တသနေ္ဒာသဗျာပတ္တိ（ထီ）
[kāyakammantasandosa+byāpatti]
[ကာယကမ္မန္တသနေ္ဒာသ+ဗျာပတ္တိ]
K:
kāyakammantasandosabyāpatti：ကာယကမ္မန္တသနေ္ဒာသဗျာပတ္တိ （ထီ）
[ကာယကမ္မန္တသနေ္ဒာသ+ဗျာပတ္တိ]
အပြစ်ရှိသော ကာယကံပျက်စီးမှု။

kāyakasāva.p: [Kāya+kasāva] (pu,na) CL=7 (Unwholesome deeds) that is done by a physical body. See - Kāyadosa. See also - Kāsāva-(3).
a: ကာယကသာဝ(ပု၊န)
ကိုယ်ဖြင့် ပြုအပ်သော အကာ(ဒုစရိုက်)။ ကာယဒေါသ-ကြည့်။ ကာသာဝ-(၃)-လည်းကြည့်။

B:
kāyakasāva： kāyakasāva（pu，na）
ကာယကသာဝ（ပု၊န）
[kāya+kasāva]
[ကာယ+ကသာဝ]
K:
kāyakasāva：ကာယကသာဝ （ပု၊န）
[ကာယ+ကသာဝ]
ကိုယ်ဖြင့် ပြုအပ်သော အကာ （ဒုစရိုက်）။ ကာယဒေါသ-ကြည့်။ ကာသာဝ-（၃）-လည်းကြည့်။
R:
kāyakasāva：ကာယ-ကသာဝ （ပ）
ကိုယ်၏ စွန်းညစ်ခြင်း။
CPD: kāya-kasāva, m., impurity of the body, cf. kasāva 4., q.v.; tayo kasāvā … ~o vacī‑° mano‑°, Vibh 368, 25 qu. Pj ll 108, 12 ; see kāyavaṅka.

kāyakilamatha.p: [Kāya+kilamatha] (pu) CL=7 The pain or suffering of the body. See original.

ကာယကိလမထ（ပု）
[kāya+kilamatha]
[ကာယ+ကိလမထ]

[ကာယ+ကိလမထ]

R:
